item.title: CT Senate clashes, passes ’emergency’ bill on warehouse workers, nonprofits, taxes, bottle returns
item.description: Republicans and Democrats clashed Wednesday at the state Capitol over emergency legislation on a wide variety of subjects, including warehouse workers, voter data, and bottle returns. Republicans said that Democrats who control both chambers of the legislature were abusing their powers to rush through bills that would normally not be debated until the end of the legislative session.
